evidence.quote: Table 11. Changes in Body Weight at Week 64 in Study 7 with WEGOVY 25 mg Tablets | Study 7 (Obesity or Overweight with Comorbidity) Intention-to-Treat^1 | PLACEBO N = 102 | WEGOVY 25 mg Tablet N = 205 - % difference from placebo (LSMean) (95% CI)^3 | | 45.1 [33.8; 56.3]^2

response.reasoning: The claim states that people taking WEGOVY 25 mg tablets lost an average of 19.6% of their body weight, compared with 2.4% with placebo. The label excerpts provide the necessary information to support this claim. Table 11 in excerpt id="wegovy:v19:40:20" shows that the least squares mean (LSMean) percentage change from baseline in body weight at Week 64 for WEGOVY 25 mg tablets is -13.6, and for placebo is -2.4. The LSMean percentage difference from placebo is 45.1 [33.8; 56.3]. This supports the claim that people taking WEGOVY 25 mg tablets lost an average of 19.6% of their body weight, compared with 2.4% with placebo.
